membership.title: Membership tiers
membership.lead: Pick the tier that fits your career stage. All prices are placeholders pending the founding board’s pricing decision.
membership.configBody: Tier names, prices (USD) and benefits are driven by src/config/site.ts. No sales tax is charged on membership dues.

join.title: Join ADAIG
join.lead: Three quick steps. Your membership activates immediately after payment.
join.emailHint: Corporate seat holders: use your company email.
join.passwordHint: At least 12 characters; not a common password. Spaces, paste and password managers are allowed.
join.dir: List me in the member directory (you can change this anytime)
join.mkt: Yes, email me ADAIG news, events and offers. I can unsubscribe at any time using the link in every email.
join.pci: Payments via Stripe hosted checkout (PCI SAQ-A). Test mode only. All amounts placeholder.
join.mock: Stripe keys not configured — mock checkout will be used.
join.attest: I confirm I am currently enrolled full-time (or in a recognised career-change programme) and can provide proof if asked.
join.verifyHint: Your Student membership is pending until ADAIG staff verify eligibility (usually 2 business days).
join.err_pw_short: Your password must be at least 12 characters.
join.err_pw_long: Your password must be 128 characters or fewer.
join.err_pw_blank: Your password can’t be only spaces.
join.err_pw_common: That password is too common or easy to guess. Choose another.
join.err_email: Enter a valid email address (for example name@example.com).
join.err_name: Enter your first and last name (up to 100 characters each).
join.err_org: Enter your organisation (up to 150 characters; “Independent” if none).
join.err_country: Choose a country from the list.
join.err_province: Choose a valid province or territory.
join.err_student: Student tier: enter your institution (up to 150 characters) and confirm the eligibility attestation.
join.err_tier: Choose a membership tier from the list.
join.err_generic_account: We couldn’t create an account with these details. If you already have an account, sign in first, then continue. Otherwise check the details and try again.
join.alreadyMember: You already have a membership in progress or active, so you can’t join again. Manage it from your dashboard.
join.unpaidBody: Continue to payment, cancel it, or choose a different tier or currency below. Submitting the form replaces the unpaid order.
join.orderCancelled: Your unpaid order was cancelled. Nothing was charged.
join.expiresNote: Unpaid orders are cancelled automatically after {hours} hours.
join.msg_orderCancelled: Your unpaid order was cancelled. Nothing was charged.
join.msg_orderNotFound: We couldn’t find that order on your account. Nothing was charged.
join.msg_orderClosed: That order is no longer open (cancelled or expired). Start a new one from Join.
join.msg_ticketNotFound: We couldn’t find that ticket on your account. Nothing was charged.
join.err_state: Choose a valid US state, DC or territory.

auth.name: Full name
auth.locked: Too many failed sign-in attempts for this account. Please wait a few minutes (up to 15) and try again.

events.title: Events & webinars
events.lead: Webinars, chapter meetups and the annual summit. Members see member pricing automatically.
events.registeredBody: Your seat is saved. Calendar invites and email are not wired up in the MVP.
events.waitStripeBody: Payment not confirmed yet. Your seat is held as pending until Stripe confirms.
events.mockBody: No Stripe keys configured. This simulates a successful card payment — no money moves.
events.pending: Payment pending — your seat is not confirmed yet.
events.tbcBlocked: Non-member pricing for this event isn’t set yet. Join ADAIG to register at the member price.
events.cadOnly: Ticket prices are in US dollars (USD).
events.payUnavailableBody: Online payment is temporarily unavailable. Your seat or membership has not been charged. Please try again later or contact ADAIG.

dash.pendingVerBody: Payment received. Your Student membership activates once ADAIG staff verify eligibility.
dash.recWhy: Suggested from upcoming events you haven’t registered for (no AI or profiling used).
dash.rejectedRefund: Your payment has been flagged for a manual refund. ADAIG staff will process it and contact you.
dash.rejectedNoRefund: Contact ADAIG staff if you have questions about your payment.
dash.rejectedSwitch: You can join under another tier instead.
dash.alreadyMember: You already have a membership in progress or active, so you can’t join again. Manage it from your dashboard.

profile.title: Profile & privacy
profile.deleteBody: This permanently removes your name, contact details, profile, CPE log and preferences, and signs you out. Invoices, payment records and the audit log are kept in anonymised form, as required for tax and financial record-keeping (7 years). Any active membership is cancelled without refund.
profile.deleteConfirm: I understand this can’t be undone
profile.deleteWrong: Password incorrect or confirmation not ticked. Nothing was deleted.
profile.deleteLastAdmin: You are the last admin. Promote another admin before deleting your account.
